description: Source code for an Odoo wizard module handling auction lot data submission and image uploads, including web requests and threading.

classes.name: wiz_auc_lots_pay
classes.description: Wizard interface class for auction lot submission process with defined states.

methods.name: _catalog_send
methods.description: Posts catalog data to remote server via multipart/form-data POST request.

methods.name: _photo_bin_send
methods.description: Uploads a photo binary to remote server via multipart/form-data POST request.

methods.name: _photos_send
methods.description: Retrieves image data for lots and uploads each image.

methods.name: _get_dates
methods.description: Fetches auction dates from external website and updates selection options.

methods.name: _send
methods.description: Prepares lot data, initiates catalog and photo uploads in separate threads.

methods.name: _send_pdf
methods.description: Starts the asynchronous send process in a new thread.
